canonical_project: Second National Data Center at Yamoussoukro innovation park
owner: Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalization / Cybastion Institute of Technology
notes: DigitalMag reported the digital transition minister's April 29, 2026 statement that, after the national data center being built at VITIB/Grand-Bassam, the government wants to build a second facility of the same capacity at Yamoussoukro in an innovation park. The article gives the reference design as Tier III, 20,000 sqm, 2 x 400 racks, 1 MW power and more than 2,200 Tb of storage; EXIM primary sources separately confirm the $66.1m Cybastion-backed national data center financing and VITIB location for the first site.
